title: Deciphering sepsis: An observational bioinformatic analysis of gene expression in granulocytes from GEO dataset GSE123731.
authors: Jin, Li; He, Xiaowei; Wang, Yuanyuan; Shao, Feng; Qian, Jun; Jiang, Mengxiao; Zhang, Shengjie; Liao, Wenjie
one_liner_zh: 基于GEO数据集的脓毒症粒细胞差异表达基因与蛋白互作分析，仅含转录因子分析但无TF-DNA结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联薄弱。
abstract: Sepsis triggers severe inflammatory responses leading to organ dysfunction and demands early diagnostic and therapeutic intervention. This study identifies differentially expressed genes (DEGs) in sepsis patients using the Gene Expression Omnibus database to find potential diagnostic and therapeutic markers. We analyzed the dataset GSE123731 via GEO2R to detect DEGs, constructed protein-protein interaction networks, and performed transcription factor analyses using Cytoscape. Gene Ontology and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes pathway analyses were conducted using R and FunRich software. Key genes were validated by Quantitative Reverse Transcription Polymerase Chain and co-immunoprecipitation assays in granulocytes from sepsis patients. We identified 59 DEGs significantly involved in neutrophil degranulation and immune system activation. Cytokine signaling pathways were highlighted in Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes analysis. Co-immunoprecipitation assays confirmed interactions involving matrix metallopeptidase 8, matrix metallopeptidase 9, and arginase 1, supporting their roles as biomarkers. The identified DEGs and validated interactions reveal crucial molecular mechanisms in sepsis, offering new avenues for diagnostic and therapeutic strategies, potentially enhancing patient outcomes.
abstract_zh: 脓毒症触发强烈的炎症反应，导致器官功能障碍，并需要早期诊断和治疗干预。本研究利用Gene Expression Omnibus数据库识别脓毒症患者中的差异表达基因（DEGs），以寻找潜在的诊断和治疗标志物。我们通过GEO2R分析数据集GSE123731以检测DEGs，构建蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络，并使用Cytoscape进行转录因子分析。使用R和FunRich软件进行Gene Ontology和Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes通路分析。通过定量逆转录聚合酶链反应和共免疫沉淀实验，在脓毒症患者的粒细胞中验证关键基因。我们识别出59个DEGs，显著涉及中性粒细胞脱颗粒和免疫系统激活。Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes分析中突出了细胞因子信号通路。共免疫沉淀实验确认了涉及基质金属肽酶8、基质金属肽酶9和精氨酸酶1的相互作用，支持它们作为生物标志物的作用。所识别的DEGs和验证的相互作用揭示了脓毒症中的关键分子机制，为诊断和治疗策略提供了新途径，可能改善患者预后。
